newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline eases as crude futures pare gains.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline eases as crude futures pare gains.

text.p: NWE gasoline eased slightly in line with falls in crude futures as the market got back into gear following Monday's public holiday across much of Europe, traders said.
Eurograde barges traded at $207 and $207.25 a tonne fob AR in the morning to the same Norwegian player.
Swaps were talked around $206.50/$208 for June, off 50 cents to $1 from Monday. The June/July spread widened by $1 with July standing some $6 below June, while August was seen $3 below July.

Traders said prices had eased in line with falls in crude futures -- July IPE Brent stood 23 cents lower at $19.93 at 1136 GMT with many futures traders saying deteriorating refinery margins were stalling further gains.

Traders said the market would now be focusing its attention on the American Petroleum Institute (API) data out late on Tuesday. "It will be interesting to see what NYMEX unleaded does later on and also what the U.S. stock situation is," said one trader.
Traders said healthy demand out of Britain and Germany should help counterbalance the effect of crude's downward pressure.
